import json, subprocess, sys, os
PY = sys.executable
env = dict(os.environ)
env['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'
env['PYTHONHASHSEED'] = '0'

def call(data, cwd='/workspace'):
    p = subprocess.Popen([PY, '-B', '-u', 'submission/main.py'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                         stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd=cwd, env=env)
    out, err = p.communicate(data if isinstance(data, bytes) else json.dumps(data).encode())
    return p.returncode, out, err

cases = [
    (b'', b'{"error":"invalid_json"}'),
    (b'{"streams":[]}', b'{"streams":[]}'),
    (b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"streams":[]}', b'{"error":"invalid_json"}'),
    (b'{"a":1,"a":2}', b'{"error":"invalid_json"}'),
]
for data, expect in cases:
    code, out, err = call(data)
    ok = code == 0 and json.loads(out.decode()) == json.loads(expect.decode()) and not err
    print(('PASS ' if ok else 'FAIL '), data[:40], code, out[:80], err[:200])

# full example request via CLI
fixtures = json.load(open('/workspace/examples.json'))
for f in fixtures:
    data = f.get('raw')
    data = data.encode() if data is not None else json.dumps(f['request']).encode()
    code, out, err = call(data)
    ok = code == 0 and json.loads(out.decode()) == f['expected']
    print(('PASS ' if ok else 'FAIL ') + f['name'], code, err[:200])

# large request through a pipe
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
big = json.load(open('/dev/null')) if False else None
PYEOF
